Topics covered in this PDF

BCOC-132 (Business Organisation and Management) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • MSMEs and Udyog Aadhaar, partnership versus joint stock company, planning, barriers to communication, financial management
  • Creativity, invention and innovation, McGregor's Theory X and Y, employee empowerment, leadership styles, government companies, forms of organisation, organising, departmentation, corporate responsibility

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
